blockingIssues.description: Remediation did not fully close the mission/orchestration metadata scope-overreach blocker; `.factory/*` artifacts introduced by `d79c6dd` remain in the effective migrated state and were not removed/reverted by `a439ea7`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify whether committed `.factory/*` artifacts are considered mission/orchestration metadata that must be removed when a scope-overreach fix is requested.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The remediation removed other out-of-scope files but left `.factory/*` unchanged, and reviewer evidence shows that this ambiguity blocked closure.
